tasks.label: Create CI integration test issue
tasks.command:
gh issue create --title 'Enable Houdini integration tests in CI environment' --body $'## Overview
Enable running Houdini integration tests in CI/CD pipeline using hython.

## Requirements
- [x] Code to locate Houdini download links (already implemented)
- [ ] Configure CI to install Houdini with hython
- [ ] Set up automated license handling for CI
- [ ] Create CI workflow that runs integration tests via hython

## Complexity
This is a complex setup requiring:
- Houdini installation in CI environment
- License management for automated testing
- Integration with existing pytest/hython test infrastructure

## Related Files
- `.github/workflows/` (CI configuration)
- `tests/conftest.py` (hython session management)
- `src/zabob_houdini/houdini_bridge.py` (subprocess execution)

## Priority
Medium - Would improve confidence in releases but not blocking current development' --label 'enhancement,ci/cd'
